subject: VM cadence + SLA snapshot for FinAdvance SOC2 review
messages:
From: Claire Beaumont <security@finadvance.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Jack Liu <jack+infosec@finadvance.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Request: VM cadence documentation + recent scan artifacts

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As part of our SOC2 evidence pack we need a short operational snapshot that covers:
- Weekly container image scans (tool + policies)
- Monthly authenticated internal network scans
- SLA for critical/high CVE remediation and an attestation for the last 90 days
- Proof of at least one recent remediation with timeline and patch notes

Can you send the minimal artifacts (scan summary PDFs and an attestation doc) and a couple of bullets describing your cadence and who owns triage? Were aiming to close this section by EOW.

Attachable artifacts are fine as PDFs. If you have a single one-page summary that maps to the SOC2 control ID (CC6.x), that would be ideal.

Appreciate it — Claire

--
Claire Beaumont
Head of Information Security, FinAdvance
security@finadvance.com
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Claire Beaumont <security@finadvance.com>
Cc: Jack Liu <jack+infosec@finadvance.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 09:12:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM cadence documentation + recent scan artifacts

Hi Claire,

Thanks — attaching a compact packet that should map to the control. Short summary here:

- Scan cadence:
  * Container image scans: weekly (scheduled; Trivy v0.40, CI-integrated, baseline policies defined in repo).
  * Authenticated internal scans: monthly (Nessus authenticated scan, credential vaulted via HashiCorp Vault).
  * External perimeter scans: bi-weekly (third-party-managed).
- Remediation SLA:
  * Critical (CVSS 9-10): 7 calendar days to remediation + rollback plan; emergency hotfix within 48 hours when actively exploited.
  * High (CVSS 7-8.9): 30 days standard patch window; exceptions require documented risk acceptance.
  * Medium/Low: prioritized by risk and service impact, typically 60/90 days.
- Ownership: Security intake -> triage by Security Engineering (ben_carter); fixes routed to Service Owners (LAUREN) with tracked JIRA tickets and weekly remediation sprints.

Attachments in this thread: finadvance-container-scan-20260320.pdf (summary of last weekly container run) and a one-page CSV-style remediation index. Also including a short attestation PDF (cve-attestation-20260322.pdf) drafted by Ben that confirms the last 90 days.

If you want a single-page mapping to SOC2 control IDs, I can produce that next.

Thanks,
Stephanie

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: finadvance-container-scan-20260320.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: remediation-index-20260320.csv (csv)]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Beaumont <security@finadvance.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 15:30:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM cadence documentation + recent scan artifacts

Claire, Stephanie,

Adding the formal attestation and a bit more operational context. Quick points:

- Attestation: We confirm that for the period 2025-12-22 to 2026-03-22 Redwood maintained the scan cadence described below and adhered to the remediation SLAs for all tickets classified as Critical. The attached cve-attestation-20260322.pdf includes the JIRA keys, remediation completion dates, and owner assignments for the last 90 days.

- Evidence highlights (from the attachment):
  * Ticket RWD-4432 (critical): discovered 2026-02-18, patch gated and deployed 2026-02-24 (6 days), verified in staging and prod; rollback tested.
  * Ticket RWD-4629 (high): discovered 2026-01-11, owner accepted patch window, remediated 2026-02-10 (30 days).

- Compensating controls: For any scheduled exception we maintain WAF rules or host-based mitigation until full patching is applied; examples and rule IDs are in the attestation PDF.

- Next steps: We can generate a concise SOC2-control mapping doc. If FinAdvance needs a scanned XLS with per-ticket CVE IDs mapped to our remediation notes, say so and well export.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: cve-attestation-20260322.pdf (pdf)]
From: Claire Beaumont <security@finadvance.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 17:02:21 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: VM cadence documentation + recent scan artifacts

Thanks — packet received and thats perfect. I reviewed RWD-4432 and the timeline looks clean for SOC2 evidence.

Two quick follow-ups:
- Can you add the JIRA ticket export (CSV) to the attestation PDF or share a Drive link?
- For the SOC2 auditor, they often ask for a single-sheet table mapping the control to artifact filenames and who signed/attested. If you could drop that on the Drive link you shared, well slot it into the pack.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Claire
